messages:
maya: Heads-up: Meridian CISO rejected our questionnaire answers (retention + BYO-KMS). They want BYO keys in pilot and expect trial pricing to include committed discount. Need quick unblock for exec call tomorrow. @ajay @oliver

devon: Can offer staged approach: hosted-managed keys for pilot + BYO-KMS path (infra validation ~3w).

ajay: I'll draft a succinct questionnaire reply and attach redacted audit logs. BYO-KMS on Private only; Dedicated needs infra validation.

oliver: Finance can provide a provisional credit to match their expected trial discount for up to 30 days pending contract. Need PO + scope to approve.

sarah: I'll prepare PO template and provisional credit terms. Maya, share trial scope and customer contacts.

maya: Shared scope + contacts in thread DM. Assign: ajay -> reply + logs by 15:00; devon -> canary plan; sarah -> PO; oliver -> credit terms. Scheduling exec bridge now.

(End of thread)
